column4: Oh! Hello, Miranda. Won't you have a cup of tea and visit for a while?
But I have to prepare these herbs. Maybe a raincheck?
You're always welcome. You can stop by anytime. I've got all the latest gossip!
Yuuukiii, I'm back. Is supper ready?
What? Get out of the way!
And there we have it. Heh, heh.
Hey! What's the big idea?! You can't just chop it up!
Now she'll fly farther. By a mile.
You think I just threw this together?! It took a lot of planning! It's custom-made and hand crafted! Everything from the angle of the propeller to the weight of the body is precisely calculated to--
Look, ya gotta have a little faith in me. I know what I'm doing.
I know her as well as you do, inside and out, and I could tell during the last test flight that we could make her lighter.
Yuki... Do you really think this is gonna work?
As far as I know, there's only been one. One person who's ever successfully flown across the sea.
And that would be Sky Captain Schmidt.
But we've tried so hard. I just know we're gonna be the next ones to make it.
We're already halfway there. This Flight Unit is all we need!
Yuuukiii! I know you're in there!
I call dibs on the plane!
H-hey! What are you doing?! Trying to kill me or something?!
Instead of fixing dinner, you're out here monkeying with your machines! Hmpf! Honestly, Yuki, when are you going to give up this nonsense and--
And train to be a potter? I know, I know.
I'll start tomorrow, I promise! Right, Rotts?
Huh? Oh, um, yeah, sure. Tomorrow.
Hmm... You seem suspiciously reasonable today. You're not up to something, are you?
Tsk. Well, in that case... I suppose you won't mind if I hang on to this then?
Uh, no-- C'mon, would I disobey my own mother? O-of course not.
Hnn... All right, then. See you later.
Just leave Miranda to me, okay? I happen to know about her "secret" hiding place in the kitchen.
Let's get ready. We're taking off tonight!
Listen, you've never flown at night. Y'gotta be careful during takeoff.
The plane's gonna be just fine.
Do I have to spell it out for you? It's not the plane I'm worried about!
Wow! When did you do this...?
I'm leaving the village soon myself.
Yuki, no matter what happens, you've gotta make it to the mainland. Meet me there, promise?
Just remember, Yuki... Our dream can even fly all the way across the ocean!
And you'll be the one to prove it, okay?
Funny. I'm not gaining any altitude.
I don't get it. I lightened her up enough!
Why don't you try moving the stick again?
I am! But it doesn't work!
Ohhhh, for goodness sake. Let me do it!
Will you be quiet! I need to concentrate!
Wha-?! Miranda!! What are you doing here?!
Huh? Heh-heh! You should know by now you can't hide anything from me, Yuki!
It's no wonder she won't fly. We're overweight!
See? There you go. What would you do without me? How about showing a little gratitude?
Excuse me, I'm a little busy here!
C'mon! Can't you do anything about this?!
Ya! Ya! Ya! Faster! Faster! Get her!
Huh?! Hey, Yuki, look at that!
I told you. I'm a little busy right now-- Uh?
Ya! Ya! Catch her! Don't let her get away!
Master Kornell! We can't find the Communicator anywhere!
One girl alone in the forest isn't going to get far. Not on foot.
Search the area and find that Communicator!
I will find you...! The glory will be mine...!
No! I have to... at least save this!
There goes our dream... Up in flames...
I had no idea that airplanes were so flimsy. You add one extra passenger, and boom!
And just whose fault was that, huh?!
Well, it all worked out OK. I mean, at least we're safe.
So, you're the meddlers who got in our way?
But I've never heard of a Communicator's bodyguards attacking from the sky before...
You think you're pretty smart, huh?!
I've never seen you two before.
We're gonna get that Communicator, no matter what it takes!
I heard something over there! C'mon!
Hmpf. It was somewhere around here...
Come on, let's get outta here!
Please let me through! Move aside, Raven!
You're making it harder for yourself! Reconsider, Alfina!
I... I have to see my brother, Raven!
But he doesn't want you to live the life of a Communicator!
Well e-even if that's true, I still... have to see him.
Get away from that girl! Hmph!
I'll ask you one more time.
Are you going to change your mind or not, Alfina?
I have to know the truth, Raven.
I must. I need to find out about my brother, myself, and the future.
Very well, Alfina. So be it.
I know what I have to do. But there isn't much time.
Are you all right? Did he hurt you?
If we hang around here much longer, we'll probably run into more of those weirdos. Let's go back to the village.
Ohhh... Rotts is gone. He left already... Darn.
What are you waiting for? Go in and see her. Go on!
Well, um... this is called chamomile.
Thank you for saving me last night. My name is Alfina.
Miranda has already told me your name.
What are you two up to?
Now, let's look at that leg.
Here. This should do the trick.
Would you mind telling me something?
Why were you being chased by those men?
I was... I was just trying to get home to Arcriff.
Are you talking about Arcriff on the mainland? The place that has that enormous temple?
So you don't know who they were. Or do you?
I don't. I'd never seen them before in my life.
I understand how you feel. But you have to get your rest. You don't want to get all bruised up now, do you?
There you are. Good as new.
We won't ask any more questions, okay?
And we'll take you part way, if Mendi Harbor's good enough.
No. Thank you but, I can't let you do that.
Well, Yuki, what do you think?
That settles it! We'll be ready to leave in 2 or 3 days.
We'll check it out. Stay right here, Alfina. Don't move.
I'm warning you! Let Gladys go right now!
I'm looking for somebody who may have wandered in here during the night.
A young blonde girl by the name of Alfina. She's a Communicator. Seen her?
I won't hurt... the old lady.
Hey! Did you come here with that guy in black?!
In black? What're you talking about?
Help! Rescue me, Yuki! Stop him! This brute's trying to kidnap me! Hurry!!
I'm not trying to kidnap you!
Since he can't find that blonde girl he's searching for... he's going to carry off vibrant, young, beautiful me instead!
No, I'm not! Are you insane!
Then, after he kidnaps me, he'll likely sell me into slavery on the mainland for a handsome price, and I'll be forced to work in some sleazy bar for the rest of my natural life!
That's it, isn't it! That's what you're planning! You monsterrrr...!! Agh!
Just shut up, you old bag!!
But enough fun. We're going to have to ask you to leave now.
How... dare... you...! How DARE you...!!
Hmph! I'll get you for this, remember that! I swear! You'll pay dearly! Hah!
I'm so sorry. He would never have come here if it wasn't for me.
Don't be silly, Alfina. Y'hear me?
There isn't a bad person in this entire village. Any of them would be happy to help you. I know one in particular... right there.
Heh. Hmm...? What is it? What're you two talking about?
A change in plans. We have to leave the village right away, before those thugs return. So, tell me when you're ready to head out of here, Yuki.
Hmm... Yes. Not bad at all.
This'll do fine. Let's set up camp here tonight.
This? It's a kind of alarm. If somebody tries to sneak up on us, we'll know. See?
That's a pit trap. It's a deep hole covered with leaves to camouflage it. If somebody walks on top of it, they'll fall in and get stuck.
Say, uh, Yuki, um... I'd like to help. Is there anything that I can do?
Well, why don't you go fix some food? There's cooking gear in my knapsack.
You can find plenty of food in the forest. For instance, the mushrooms that grow around here are delicious.
All right, then. I'll do my best to gather what I can!
She's a good kid. Sweet and gentle. And awfully cute, too.
Heh! So many cute little mushrooms...
There's no sugar. You'll have to use chocolate.
Um, Alfina, can I ask you something?
Even though you've been chased... nearly scared to death... and injured...
...You're still bound and determined to go to Arcriff. How come?
Because that's where I might be able to find the answer I seek.
I need to know. I have to find out why the two of us were born to be Communicators.
Yes. You see, my brother was supposed to be the Communicator.
But... during his first ceremony, he refused to talk to the Guardian. That was 3 years ago.
And then he just ran away.
All he left behind... was this, his Communicator's Brooch.
It really has an unusual shape.
It kind of... looks like the wing of a bird.
I wonder why... he just left.
The very idea of becoming a Communicator terrifies me.
Sometimes... I simply want to run away from it all.
Maybe this is what my purpose in life has been all along.
And if that's actually the case, I can't run away from my destiny...
I'm sorry. Bothering you with my problems is the last thing I should do.
Hmpf. It's about time. I've been waiting for you.
You've been waiting for us? You mean you've been waiting for help!
Come on. We've got to get going, you two.
I hope you rot up in that net. Muscle-bound peabrain.
Hey. Did I hear you correctly? Did you just call me a... muscle-bound peabrain? Huh?
I said, did you just call me a peabrain?!?!
I'm through playing games with you! That does it! I'm going to kill all of you...!!
And stay there this time. You muscle-bound peabrain!
It gets awfully cold out at night, so... Here you go.
And the mainland is-- right across there?
Tsk. That's strange... I don't see any boats. Not a one in sight.
In fact, it looks like this hasn't been used in quite a while.
Hello...? Is somebody there...? Help me, please...!
You wouldn't believe what I've been through...
Um, may I offer you a handkerchief?
Okay, okay, that's enough. Since you enjoy chatting--
Why don't you try explaing how you got in there?
Well... it was just a little accident, you see.
But now I can fill my lungs with fresh air again! And gaze upward to see the sky!
And I have you three to thank for it! I'm eternally grateful to you.
If there's anything I can do in return, don't hesitate to ask!
Well, um... We're trying to get to the mainland. Could you help us get there somehow?
That's right. Maybe you know. Didn't there used to be dock here?
What's that? You're looking for a sailing vessel, then?!
You're in luck. I can get you one. She's fine, and fast, too!
If this is some sort of scam, I swear...
What? No, this is on the up-and-up. The ship is perfectly safe, I guarantee it. I give you my word as a captain!
A captain? You're telling us you're a sailor?!
Yes! The name's Alonso, madam. Intrepid sailor of the seven seas.
Hey... What's with the funny looks? Don't believe me?
Heh. Very well, then. I can prove it to you. Take a good look at this!
Oooh...! Is that... what I think it is?!
Yes! It's a map to the mainland! Wowww...!
And see this! This is Arcriff!
I believe him Miranda. The map seems real enough.
Well, I admit, you appear to be the sea-faring type.
But... can this ship of yours really carry us all the way to the mainland?
Tsk tsk tsk. What you should ask is if there's anywhere it can't go. And the answer is "no".
Guess we'll just have to wait and see.
All right. Let's get going, then.
It is a bit of a journey to the west dock. But you're in good hands.
I may not look it, but I'm a formidable fighter.
He tricked us! I knew something wasn't right!
Hey, we still have time! Let's go get it back!
Alonso...! So, you made it back alive, eh? Let's see if your good luck holds out!
How did you like floating at sea all night in that nice barrel?
It must get pretty chilly out there, hm...?
Do yourself a favor. Just give up.
It's for your own good, so you ought to listen to me, sweetie.
I'm sorry. But I didn't come here to engage in idle chatter.
I've come here to beat you, Bianca!
Hm? Hmm... Heh. Well, I suppose it's worth about...
Okay. Then I'm going to bet this brooch.
Just watch! I'll win this place away from you and everything in it!
Hmpf! Give it your best shot!
Thief! Give that brooch back to Alfina!
Back off, kid! You're too late, the game has started.
Argh! We never should've gotten involved with him!
Oh, so is this your meal ticket, Alonso? Ha! That explains where you got the brooch.
Yes... she certainly fits the type. Just look at her!
It's Arrange Dice, as usual. And you know the rules.
Please! Somebody! Lend me some money!
I should've known. Hmph! He's a loser.
See you later! Give it up, Buddy!
We don't have any money, right?
Heh. Sorry you had to witness that. Pitiful, I know...
So what're you gonna do?! About the brooch?!
Wha-?! Are you crazy?! Sorry's not gonna cut it!
Oh, do you mean this little trinket once belonged to you?
I hope the three of you learned your lesson.
Only a fool would put their faith in old Alonso the loser here.
Hey! You hold on a minute! He tricked us! We don't even know him!
It's true! He told us he was the captain of a ship!
He said he was the captain of a ship?!
Boy oh boy, now that's a good one!
How can Alonso be a captain when he doesn't even have a ship?
I see. It was all a lie.
One more time! Please! Just one more game, tomorrow!
And if you win, then I promise to make you my wife.
I never lie to a woman.
My word is a solemn bond.
Can we stay in my-- I mean your ship's cabin tonight?
I feel just awful about all this.
Somehow I managed to lose your brooch, and drag you into my problems.
Tell me, are you honestly sorry?
What am I going to do...?
That brooch is very important to me.
What are you planning to do, Alonso?! What if-
This whole mess is my fault.
No matter what it takes. I'll make it right.
I'll put it all on the line and win!
He'll win. I know he will.
I have faith in him. I believe in his strength.
Guess we don't have any choice.
Hmpf. Speak for yourself, all right?
We'll let Bianca borrow the brooch for now. But tomorrow, we're gonna get it back.
The ship is docked right over at that pier. We'll stay in her cabin tonight.
I guess a ship rocks back and forth. Even when docked.
Yes. It's soothing, isn't it? When I'm ashore on steady ground, it just doesn't feel right.
Oh. So, you like that, do you?
That, my young friend, is a piece of coral that can only be found in the South Seas. And next to it is a sacred chalice exhumed from the watery grave of a sunken temple.
Well. I guess I was completely wrong about you, Alonso.
This... is where it really belongs.
It's the map you showed us.
Hey, a part of the map is missing.
That's right. It's unfinished. Can you guess why?
I'll tell you. This map is one of a kind. It only shows the places that I've traveled to and seen with my own two eyes.
And until I've been everywhere... it'll remain incomplete.
My greatest dream is finishing this map!
So... if my map is never going to be finished, I might as well give up... my dream.
Yeah, yeah, yeah. You're breakin' my heart.
That's no excuse for tricking us. We wouldn't be in this situation if it wasn't for you.
But... that horrible woman is far worse!
Were you watching her? Even a fool like you must have noticed.
You're darn right I saw what she did.
No doubt about it. She was cheating.
I have a plan to beat Bianca.
But I'm gonna need a partner.
This is what I have in mind.
You-- idiot! I can't do that! Are you crazy?!
OK. I'll take that as a yes. So then, "yes" is your answer?
Sleeping quarters are down below. Let's all get some shut-eye.
We'll need plenty of rest for tomorrow.
Look! There he is! It's Alonso!
Alonso's here... He came. This is so exciting!
He's here! He's here! Whadaya know, he showed up.
Hey, look who just walked in... This oughta be quite a show.
So, I assume you're prepared to lose this game and win my hand, Alonso?
I give you all my word as a sailor!
Here and now, I'm wagering my precious bachelorhood at this table!
You've gotta be kidding! Marry her! I won't go along with this!
Roll the dice, Alonso. I can't wait for our honeymoon.
Now do your best, Alonso darling.
After all, this is for our future, you know.
What do you think you're doing...?! G-get your hands off my Alonso right now, you little hussy!
That should have been a 12, why isn't it?! Why, hm?!
Miserable cheater! You tricked me, Alonso!
Soooo... you knew the dice were going to turn up a 12, did you?
Give us back our money! Yeah! We're through lining your pockets!
You owe us about... Um... Wow. I don't even know where to begin counting!
You've got a problem. How are you going to pay for this?
I-- I'll pay, I'll pay, quit worrying! Look!
And if that's not enough, I can offer you my beautiful rings!
If you want something, then earn it!
If you're a cheater, I guarantee you'll never be anything but a loser.
I- I'll get you for this...! Aaaa...!
I want to split my winnings... with everyone!
Ooh, the nerve of that woman.
Trying to win someone's love by cheating. Well, I hope she gets hers someday!
But don't be too hard on Bianca.
She does what she can to get by.
It's not easy for a woman to make it alone in a place like this. Had she and
Now, we set sail! Everybody meet at the pier when you're ready!
Man, I wish I had wings, too...
I tried to fly to the mainland with it, but it- didn't work out.
I made him a promise. I told him that our dream was gonna come true. I said I'd become the best pilot in the world.
How do you know if you've succeeded? Who decides that you're the best one?
I mean, do you become the best in the world when you make it to the mainland? Or after you've flown around the world? Will you be done with flying as soon as you've done these things?
No, I never wanna stop. I just want to keep flying... Higher... and higher.
Yeah... That's what dreams are like, kid.
You'd never even think about... what you'd do if they actually came true, because... you get so wrapped up in them.
You're going to fly high, Yuki. I have no doubt about it.
Hey! That's not the Alonso I remember!
Hmpf. You really saved us there, Ulf. That was perfect timing.
I thought a veteran sailor like you would have enough sense to set a course clear of the Boat Swallows' territory.
But, that's just it. They had no reason to be in this area. If you ask me, it's strange...
Do you think maybe... it's because of all those...?
Well, I can't rule it out.
His name's Yuki. He says he's an airplane pilot.
A-- air-plane?! Ahh...! Then you're a flyer, too!
Hey, that hurt! What's the big idea?!
That's just his way of saying hello. Hmpf. It's a compliment.
So, has anything odd happened recently?
Yeah... Another one of those nasty quakes hit.
I heard it even did some serious damage to a castle somewhere.
Nobody knows when those things are gonna strike next. next.
Yuki, I advise you to be careful when you're... Huh?
Your dragon-- it was flying earlier, wasn't it?
You saw us fly, didn't you? And don't call him "it." He's got a name, you know.
He goes by the name of "Shiba." Got that?
Heh. Well, Yuki? Like my dragon?
Oh, yeah! You bet I do! After all, I a flying! Wowww...
Why not ask Shiba? If he's in a good mood, he'll let you ride him.
Does what- we talked about earlier... have something to do with you?
I know that the Verse Realm isn't hell!
It couldn't have anything to do with towns disappearing or the end of the world. It's just not possible, Yukie!
Alfina. What is it, what's troubling you?
Why would some natural disasters upset you like this? upset you so?.
just have to get to Arcriff, no matter...
Shiba and I are going to the mainland anyway.
We'll watch from above and keep our eyes peeled for anything that looks strange.
Hey! You just made it, Yuki!
Oh, Yuki. If you're still planning to see Schmidt, you should stop at Randoto.
The guy loves Lem Fruit. It only grows on Randoto Island. It might get your foot in the door.
I swear I'll get wings of my own someday.
And then, we can both fly together!
Our paths will cross again when the south wind blows!
I know Randoto. It's a tiny island between Sabatar and Mendi.
And, we're passing right by it.
Um... uh... Alfina... This is a little difficult to ask, but, could we maybe...
Wait, let me guess. You want to go to Randoto, right?
It's okay. Let's go there, Yuki.
Thanks a lot. Thank you, Alfina.
Hang on! I've got you! Don't let go!
Watch out, Yuki! Don't get sucked in!
It's so quiet. It's not natural.
This world is dead. Like a cast- off shell...
This place can't be the Verse Realm. It just can't be!
We should Right We go. now. don't belong here, Yuki. Neither one of us.
This isn't the Verse Realm, is it?
Ever since I was a little girl, I was taught that the Guardians lived in the Verse Realm.
And they brought happiness to the world. Through us, the Communicators.
...that's why I can't believe that this... this is where the Guardians live. I won't believe it.
No happiness... Not even the faintest glimmer of life.
That's not true. There is life here.
Um, What are-- what are you doing here?
The bonds. I have to sever them.
This world must be wiped from your world's memory.
This world must be wiped from your world's memory.
Forget this world, and all that you've seen here.
Forget so that you can never return here.
Please, come with us! Don't stay!
Sorry I worried you both. But we're back, and we're okay.
What you had in mind, that was a helluva rotten stunt!
You had the two us worried sick, kid! Think of your mother!
You think an apology will make it all better, hm?
Yuki, I want to thank you.
You held my hand, didn't you?
If it wasn't for that warmth--
Well, I- I don't think I could have made it back here.
Her hands, they were so cold...
As if no blood was flowing through them.
And... her eyes were so sad.
I know I'll never forget it. I think--
You don't have to worry any more. We'll find the answer.
Come on, Alfina. We have to tell them. Let them know what we saw there.
He and Alfina. They're leaving us.
So what's the problem? Let 'em go.
What?! How can you say that?!
So what's the problem? Let 'em. go.
I a good mother? I just don't know what to do any more.
I always thought that parents ought to know their own children better than anyone. That they should be able to read their thoughts like a book.
But now things are different. I just don't understand him at all anymore.
I was in a little boat. And I got caught up in a terrible storm.
It tossed around on the water like a leaf.
Up and down... I was pitched on the waves.
I thought all was lost. But right when I gave up hope... Right when-I gave-up hope...
The dark clouds parted, and a ray of sun shone down on me.
Whenever he flies, Yuki probably feels the same way I did at that very moment.
He's a man now. He-is- a man.
In time, he'll have to go off in search of his dreams.
Hey! Alfina. Look at that! Looks good, huh...?
You two run along. We'll see you later.
Well... since we're on the mainland and all, I thought I'd fix a bit of a feast for dinner tonight.
And the finest foods from around the world can be found right here, after all.
You go on ahead and see that Schmidt person. We'll meet back at the ship later when we're done shopping.
Alfina, check this out! These wings are set all the way forward. How does he deal with wind resistance?! Agh! It's incredible!
Woooah...! Get a load of this engine!
A-- Are you Schmidt? The legendary Schmidt?
Wait...! I need an airplane! Uh!-W-wait!-44 Sir...need an airplane!
And Ulf said that we should come see you.
He said you're the one who could build us an airplane.
On the way here, we even stopped at Randoto.
Go home. I'm up to my ears in wannabe pilots.
What? Go home? Yuki, what'll we do?
Um, don't worry. Leave everything to me.
I'm a pilot. I really, am, I swear! See!
You win that at a carnival?
C'mere, kid. Ya wanna see what a real flight unit looks like?
Now I see! By making minute adjustments to the angles of the main and rear wings, the aircraft gets lift while at the same time increasing its turning performance!
Hey kid, so you mean you've built planes before?
Sure have. Nineteen in all. In fact, this one was gonna be my 20th.
B-- but this time, it's different. I-- Huh...?
So that little dragon rider helped you out, eh?
But... I haven't had anyone bring me a genuine Lem Fruit in years. Certainly not a wet-behind-the-ears kid like you.
Huh...?! You mean there are- fake Lem Fruits?!
Hey kid, go get me a #3 box wrench.
Are you hard of hearing? I said get me a #3 box wrench!
Uh... Box wrench... hmm... Ah! Here it is!
You crashed 19, hm? Why haven't you given up yet?
It's just that I love flying so much.
Oh, wow, is that-- is that a Schmidt airplane emblem?!
This is the only frame I've got that's almost ready to go.
I'll fix it up for you. kid. You can come pick it up tomorrow.
Then I guess... Miranda knows too, doesn't she?
Don't play dumb. You're going to Arcriff. With Alfina, aren't you?
Hey. Don't worry. Aw. Don't worry...
There's only one thing I wanna know.
Now that you''finally managed to get your wings...
...what exactly are you going to do with them?
There are so many things I wanna do. And so much I wanna learn.
I just know that I'll find what I'm looking for. It's somewhere... out there...!
Then go. Don't let anything stand in your way.
The answers are out there. Find
I should've kept you on a leash, I swear.
It's all right. No, I won't try to stop you.
Last night... Alonso and I had a long talk. Alonso.
So, you'll back to Anfog go Village? I
So, you'll go back to Anfong Village?
For once, I think I should make myself happy.
You helped me realize that. Thank you.
The time's come. We have our own road.
Yuki. Spread your wings and fly.
Heh. I feel like I already have. You know?
He's got a good head. He'll be fine.
When it comes to flying, madam... I assure you I never lie.
I know what you want to tell me, Yuki.
Just let me be your mother, this one last time, okay?
Yuki has finally spread his wings. Bye kid. Be glad.
He called me Mom just now.
Yuki has finally spread his wings. Bye kid.
